memory_candidates.content: When a local gate script (e.g. verify-deploy.sh / run-all.sh) fails during implementation on a shared working tree with concurrent sibling /orchestrate dispatches, do not assume the failure is your own regression. Check: (1) whether the failing check's files overlap your task's own file_scope at all; (2) whether the working tree already carried unrelated dirty files in those areas at session start (visible in the initial git status snapshot); (3) whether a sibling's own process (e.g. a second run-all.sh invocation, visible via `pgrep -af run-all.sh`) is concurrently running against the same shared tree. If all three point away from your own diff, closing the phase as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a per-check Reasoned Exclusions row (Item/Reason/Evidence) is appropriate rather than blocking on or chasing an unrelated shared-tree gate failure.
